_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 9 OF 10: THE INHERITANCE.
Somebody has inherited the plant, occupiers and all, and wants the deed before anyone else can claim it. Talk to her
at the door, deal with whoever runs the place now, and bring the deed out of the safe. The verb is CLAIM, and she
is the comedy of the family: delighted, appalled, and taking notes. The talk is FIRST, at the entrance.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Recovery: The Deed on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The owner of the <Place> died and left it to a niece, who has arrived to find it full of armed strangers.
prose.card: Private Contract. Recover the deed from the safe at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Talk to the new owner outside the <Place>
beats.journal: The new owner of the <Place> is waiting outside. Her uncle left her the plant and the deed is in the safe inside, so I need to deal with whoever runs it now.

person.name: Imogen Vey
hellos: Hello! Are you the help? Please say you're the help.

greeting: Wonderful. My uncle left me this place. I met him twice, he gave me a calculator both times. He did not mention the people with guns.

reply: It's in the safe, inside. Whoever's in charge in there will have the safe. They always have the safe, don't they?

exchanges.prompt: Calculators twice. He was trying to tell you something.
reply: Do you think so? I assumed he'd bought a box of them. Now I'll be up all night wondering.

exchanges.prompt: What will you do with it?
reply: Run it, apparently. I've bought a book.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 ends the talk and sets the next stage. Every prompt stands on the greeting. Voice 'Lauren B', unused so far; the same voice on the radio.

beats.objective: Deal with whoever runs the <Place> now
beats.journal: Whoever was in charge in there is dead. Now I need to open the safe.
say: Was that the one in charge? Oh. Oh, good. I think. I'm writing that down under 'staff', I don't know where else it goes.

beats.objective: Recover the deed from the safe
beats.journal: I took the niece's deed out of the safe at the <Place>, after dealing with the people running it.
beats.name: Site Safe

message.title: Property Deed
message.text: The deed, folded in three, on top of a calculator. Taped to the calculator: for the next one.

say: That's the deed. I suppose I own all this now.

broadcast: Hello? Is this the contractor? I'm outside. I'm not going in there, I'm wearing my good shoes. Come and find me first.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
